env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A comptime generic called inside a concrete const for of an ordinary
# function, nested const for and function literal included, runs its
# native instance and ejects to a renamed call of the printed instance.

cd m
cp ../want.txt $WORK/want.txt

logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/kinds/kinds.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
! grep 'kind\[' out/main.go
! grep 'kinds\.Kind\[' out/main.go
grep 'kind_logosct[0-9]+\(' out/main.go
grep 'Kind_logosct[0-9]+\(' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .

-- want.txt --
Port leaf leaf
Sub struct struct
  A A;B; leaf
  B A;B; leaf
Tags leaf leaf
lit A leaf
lit B leaf
-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ctforcall

go 1.27
-- m/kinds/kinds.lgo --
package kinds

import "comptime"

func Kind[F any](dst *F) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[F]() {
		return "struct"
	} else {
		return "leaf"
	}
}
-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"example.com/ctforcall/kinds"
)

type Inner struct {
	A int
	B string
}

type Cfg struct {
	Port int
	Sub  Inner
	Tags []string
}

func kind[F any](dst *F) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[F]() {
		return "struct"
	} else {
		return "leaf"
	}
}

func describe[T any]() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		b.WriteString(f.Name + ";")
	}
	return b.String()
}

func main() {
	var c Cfg
	var in Inner
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Cfg]() {
		fmt.Println(f.Name, kind[f.Type](&c.[f]), kinds.Kind[f.Type](&c.[f]))
		const if comptime.IsStruct[f.Type]() {
			const for _, g := range comptime.Fields[f.Type]() {
				fmt.Println(" ", g.Name, describe[Inner](), kind[g.Type](&in.[g]))
			}
		}
	}
	fn := func() {
		const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Inner]() {
			fmt.Println("lit", f.Name, kind[f.Type](&in.[f]))
		}
	}
	fn()
}
